title: runtime-clean skill: containers, images, volumes, networks, orphaned processes, ports, background tasks
description: Author skills/runtime-clean/SKILL.md (plus references/) with skill-creator, honouring the cleanliness-levels spec and driving hk for inventory and removal.

acceptanceCriteria.text: skills/runtime-clean/SKILL.md exists with name and a trigger-oriented description, under 500 lines
the skill states its behaviour at the housekeeping levels (Minimal to Immaculate) and scopes (session, repo, machine) it acts at, and never runs an S3 action without explicit user confirmation
skill-creator eval runs with and without the skill are recorded under evals/ with graded assertions

implementationNotes: AC3 NOT met: runtime-clean has no with/without task eval. Deliberately skipped in iteration 1: a baseline agent told to 'clean up' could prune real Docker or kill real processes on the host. Covered instead by tests/test_hk.py::test_orphaned_dev_server_in_repo_is_found_and_stopped. Needs a sandboxed runtime fixture (dedicated compose project + labelled container) before this AC can be checked.
HS-13: AC2 reworded from C1-C5 to Minimal..Immaculate + scope and unchecked; the skill was rewritten, so it is re-verified after the iteration-2 evals.
